core_obligations: Duration (1): the map is continuous for the constructible topologies immediately from the definitions (proof lines 4602-4604)
(3): the image of the constructible topology of the source is quasi-compact, hence closed in the Hausdorff constructible topology of the target (proof lines 4604-4606)

(2): the constructible fibre over a point is closed in the constructible source, hence quasi-compact, and the map from that fibre to the fibre in the given topology is surjective and continuous, so the latter is quasi-compact (proof lines 4607-4616)

(3)：f(X') 是 Hausdorff 空间 Y' 中的准紧子集 ⇒ 闭。
(2)：纤维 X'_y 在 X' 中闭 ⇒ 准紧；又 X'_y → X_y 满连续 ⇒ X_y 准紧。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows three properties of a spectral map of spectral spaces: it is continuous for the constructible topology, its fibres are quasi-compact and its image is constructibly closed (author lemma at source lines 4588-4596, label lemma-fibres-spectral-map-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 4598-4618) works with the constructible topologies, where the source and target are quasi-compact Hausdorff, and transfers quasi-compactness along the map from the constructible fibres to the fibres in the given topology (proof lines 4598-4616). The fibre comparison is the substance. H3.
